method: Start from the no-vig (margin-removed) average of the bookmakers in the live AU odds file. Adjust only when a cited public source supports the change. If a factor cannot be checked, it is marked unavailable and is not allowed to raise confidence. Weather comes from Open-Meteo; injuries, recent form and rest come from ESPN's public site API where the sport is covered.
disclaimer: Probabilities are estimates, not guarantees. Short-odds favourites around 90% pay little, so a single upset wipes out several wins.
